description.html: The 17x20x28 cm terrarium has a base of 340 cm² and about 9.5 liters of volume, and its height is greater than both its length and its width. It is vertical, with a 3D styrofoam background on the back and a mesh vent for ventilation. It is intended for small climbing animals.

Jumping spiders build their nest near the top, so 28 cm of height is more useful to them than a wide base. A mantis molts hanging upside down and needs free space beneath it. A juvenile day gecko or a small frog can stay here until it grows, and then it needs a larger terrarium. The mesh lets air through while keeping fruit flies in.

If you need more height for a plant, we build a similar base, 20x20 cm, in heights of 30, 35 and 40 cm. The background relief can be rock or bark. We also make sets of several identical terrariums to order, with a lead time of 7 to 14 days. The outside gets a decorative film that you choose when ordering, and we send the package by courier.
